functions.name: VehicleStateUpdate
functions.summary: Updates a per-vehicle lap-gap state object. functions.name: ParticleEffectWorldTransform
functions.summary: Transforms up to 17 particle-emitter positions from local to world space and spawns particles. Guards on the global particle-system pointer dword_8ACEB8; when it is non-null, iterates an emitter array of 17 slots starting at this+0x998 (this + 614 floats), each slot 7 floats wide (28 bytes). For every slot whose active-flag byte is non-zero it reads the 3x3 rotation matrix a2 and translation a3, transforms the slot position into world space, and calls ParticleSpawnFunction with the global system, world position, slot data, and the a4 parameter.

Read the active-flag byte at v5 - 8 (v6); when zero, skip this emitter slot.

Rotate the slot position into world space using rows of the 3x3 matrix a2: X = a2[1]*v5[0] + a2[2]*v5[1] + a2[0]*(v5-1), Y = a2[4]*v5[0] + a2[5]*v5[1] + a2[3]*(v5-1), Z = a2[7]*v5[0] + a2[8]*v5[1] + a2[6]*(v5-1), consuming the position components at this+0x998 (v5[0]) and this+0x99C (v5[1]).
Add the translation vector a3: world.X += a3[0], world.Y += a3[1], world.Z += a3[2].
Call ParticleSpawnFunction(v4, worldPosition, v6, v5 + 2, slotExtraByte, a4) to spawn a particle at the world-space position.

functions.name: initSuspensionGeometry
functions.summary: Initializes suspension geometry for a single wheel slot: computes the wheel offset vector from the chassis local origin, copies the suspension orientation matrix and the upright orientation matrix into per-wheel geometry storage, and extracts Euler angles from both matrices with gimbal-lock handling.
